"""Read-only component measurements; no provider requests or production writes."""
import json
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

from second_brain import governor, ledger

home = Path(sys.argv[1])
session = sys.argv[2]

def measure(fn, n=8):
    samples = []
    value = None
    for _ in range(n):
        start = time.perf_counter()
        value = fn()
        samples.append((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
    return {"median_ms": statistics.median(samples), "samples_ms": samples, "result": value}

out = {}
out["startup"] = measure(lambda: subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", "pass"], check=True).returncode)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
    empty = Path(temp)
    out["empty"] = measure(lambda: governor.check_budget(empty, "empty", "driver"))
out["telemetry"] = measure(lambda: governor._session_total_tokens(home, session))
out["enumeration"] = measure(lambda: len(list((home / "state" / "sessions").iterdir())))
files = [p / "ledger.sqlite" for p in (home / "state" / "sessions").iterdir() if (p / "ledger.sqlite").is_file()]
root = ledger.internal_session_id(session)

def components():
    totals = {"open_ms": 0.0, "query_ms": 0.0, "close_ms": 0.0, "rows": 0}
    for file in files:
        start = time.perf_counter()
        conn = governor.sqlite3.connect(file.absolute().as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True, timeout=1)
        opened = time.perf_counter()
        rows = conn.execute("SELECT internal_session_id,host_session_id FROM sessions WHERE root_parent_session_id=?", (root,)).fetchall()
        queried = time.perf_counter()
        conn.close()
        closed = time.perf_counter()
        totals["open_ms"] += (opened-start)*1000
        totals["query_ms"] += (queried-opened)*1000
        totals["close_ms"] += (closed-queried)*1000
        totals["rows"] += len(rows)
    return totals

out["ledger_components"] = measure(components)
out["direct_populated"] = measure(lambda: governor.check_budget(home, session, "driver"))
out["python_cli"] = measure(lambda: subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "second_brain", "--home", str(home), "governor", "check-budget", "--session", session, "--role", "driver"], capture_output=True, text=True).returncode, 3)
out["ledger_count"] = len(files)
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
